title: cc-probes-report-to-the-watch
intention: Every standing WATCHME probe berthed in cairn/devices/cc reports to harbor_master's watch verb with {ticket, holds, finding} stated against its own ticket's falsifier, and each spec names that receiver.
why: Every standing probe in cairn/devices/cc mails with no verb and nothing uses it (835b5736bf2b D2); a88d6a368cfb built the watch verb that uses a WATCHME finding and 8ecb99998254 built watch_carry. Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: build the receivers.
traces_to: 835b5736bf2b's falsifier (zero probe-bearing standing specs lack a receiver) and Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a; the 2026-09-30 ruling that a probe's data must have a consumer that USES it; RULE 1 (the build stays inside cairn/devices/cc; base's helper through its public interface, harbor_master through its bus verb)
how: Measured 2026-10-03: 2 tickets at a rest carry a watchme probe under cairn/devices/cc/probes/ (15b80c0c393c, a6cf55a6dd6d). Read 2026-10-03: three standing tickets carry a probe under cairn/devices/cc/probes, all posting to='harbor_master' with no verb. None is fails-shaped: a_restart_leaves_a_slate_behind_it (15b80c0c393c) triggers on any restart consumed since its watermark, and its carry pairs the newest with a slate, writing the watermark — so holds is that pairing's paired (or no fresh restart), and since watch_carry runs carry before the predicate, the pairing is passed through context; is_the_memory_curve_recorded (a6cf55a6dd6d) triggers while memory_series.jsonl has entries, so holds is the same count > 0; the_shim_delivers_mail (078476729bca) triggers on context['diagnostics_received'] > 0 and nothing in cairn, skills or bin sets that key (grep 2026-10-03), so it can never fire or conclude and no receiver can use its data — the b0c0c47835c1 precedent (8ecb99998254 D7): FIXME through the watch verb. Proofs that import cc probes: test_cc_device (the_shim_delivers_mail's PROBE.to == harbor_master, unchanged), test_groundloop_pulse (the pulse roster), test_memory_probe (memory_curve only, not a converted probe), and skills/restart/proofs/test_restart_selector (the restart probe is a Probe with why, carry and enough). Each PROBE gets verb='watch' and carry=watch_carry(<its id>, _carry, <its predicate>), importing watch_carry from cairn.tools.base.probe (declared public). Each ticket's watchme spec gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} through the artifact door. A proof under cairn/devices/cc/proofs reads the population from the commons and asserts each probe's verb, to, and live payload invariants.
falsifier: GREEN when every ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme.probe sits under cairn/devices/cc has a probe whose PROBE posts verb 'watch' to 'harbor_master' and whose payload over live data carries ticket == that ticket's id, holds a bool, and a non-empty finding whenever holds is False; and every such spec names receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} with watchme_spec_error naming no receiver fault. RED if any standing cc spec lacks the receiver, or if a converted payload's ticket is a path or another id. WRONG INTENT if a cc probe's data has a reader other than its own ticket's FIXME that only Akien could name.
watchme: none, because what this child's probes say is read by harbor_master's watch verb (a88d6a368cfb, PROVED), and whether they ever fire is 164da559823d's and acb4ecd84364's watch (CairnCommons/tickets/164da559823d-*.json); a probe on probes reporting would need a receiver of its own.
children: none, because the change is 2 PROBE declarations and their specs, all inside cairn/devices/cc.
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Which probes and how: 15b80c0c393c a_restart_leaves_a_slate_behind_it (holds=_holds), a6cf55a6dd6d is_the_memory_curve_recorded (holds=_holds). In each file under cairn/devices/cc/probes/: append watch_carry to the existing 'from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...' line; use the probe's id constant (named per probe below, added as `_TICKET_ID = "<id>"` after the import block when absent); in PROBE = Probe(...) replace 'carry=_carry,' with 'verb="watch",' and 'carry=watch_carry(<const>, _carry, <pred>),'. Both triggers say 'speak', not 'something is wrong', so each gains a holds predicate, added just above PROBE = Probe(: in a_restart_leaves_a_slate_behind_it (15b80c0c393c, constant _TICKET already holds the bare id) add _carry_watched and _holds exactly as follows and pass carry=watch_carry(_TICKET, _carry_watched, holds=_holds): def _carry_watched(context: dict) -> dict: ⏎     """The pairing, kept in context so _holds reads the restart this carry just moved the ⏎     watermark past (watch_carry runs the carry before the predicate; 835b5736bf2b child).""" ⏎     out = _carry(context) ⏎     context["_pairing"] = out ⏎     if out.get("consumed") is not None and not out.get("paired"): ⏎         out["finding"] = (f"restart {out['consumed']} has no slate written within the minute " ⏎                           "before its consumed stamp") ⏎     return out ⏎  ⏎  ⏎ def _holds(context: dict) -> bool: ⏎     """A restart with no slate behind it is the failure; no fresh restart is not one.""" ⏎     p = context.get("_pairing") or {} ⏎     return p.get("consumed") is None or bool(p.get("paired")) ; in is_the_memory_curve_recorded (a6cf55a6dd6d, _TICKET holds a slug and stays; add _TICKET_ID) add _holds exactly as follows and pass carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds): def _holds(context: dict) -> bool: ⏎     """The trigger says "speak" (a recorded sample), not "something is wrong": the recorder ⏎     holds while the series has entries (835b5736bf2b child).""" ⏎     return _series_count() > 0 . a_restart_leaves_a_slate_behind_it also declares verb="" in its Probe(...); that line is removed (verb="watch" replaces it). The third standing cc probe, the_shim_delivers_mail (078476729bca), is NOT converted: see the unreceivable decision. Nothing else in a probe changes. (2) watch_carry exists in cairn/tools/base/probe.py (8ecb99998254); do not edit it. (3) Specs: each ticket's watchme spec whose probe starts with cairn/devices/cc/probes/ gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}, through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write. (4) Proof: cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_cc_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, PROVES {'802b3e49ae70': {'all': 'test_cc_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}, modeled on cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py. (5) Every proof that imports a converted probe stays green: run them.

decisions.text: D1: the probes — In each of these files under cairn/devices/cc/probes/: a_restart_leaves_a_slate_behind_it.py (15b80c0c393c: constant _TICKET — already present; holds=_holds), is_the_memory_curve_recorded.py (a6cf55a6dd6d: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; holds=_holds) — append watch_carry to the existing `from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...` line; where the constant is to be added, add `_TICKET_ID = "<its id>"` after the import block; in `PROBE = Probe(...)` replace `carry=_carry,` with `verb="watch",` and `carry=watch_carry(<constant>, _carry, <its predicate>),`. Both triggers say 'speak', not 'something is wrong', so each gains a holds predicate, added just above PROBE = Probe(: in a_restart_leaves_a_slate_behind_it (15b80c0c393c, constant _TICKET already holds the bare id) add _carry_watched and _holds exactly as follows and pass carry=watch_carry(_TICKET, _carry_watched, holds=_holds): def _carry_watched(context: dict) -> dict: ⏎     """The pairing, kept in context so _holds reads the restart this carry just moved the ⏎     watermark past (watch_carry runs the carry before the predicate; 835b5736bf2b child).""" ⏎     out = _carry(context) ⏎     context["_pairing"] = out ⏎     if out.get("consumed") is not None and not out.get("paired"): ⏎         out["finding"] = (f"restart {out['consumed']} has no slate written within the minute " ⏎                           "before its consumed stamp") ⏎     return out ⏎  ⏎  ⏎ def _holds(context: dict) -> bool: ⏎     """A restart with no slate behind it is the failure; no fresh restart is not one.""" ⏎     p = context.get("_pairing") or {} ⏎     return p.get("consumed") is None or bool(p.get("paired")) ; in is_the_memory_curve_recorded (a6cf55a6dd6d, _TICKET holds a slug and stays; add _TICKET_ID) add _holds exactly as follows and pass carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds): def _holds(context: dict) -> bool: ⏎     """The trigger says "speak" (a recorded sample), not "something is wrong": the recorder ⏎     holds while the series has entries (835b5736bf2b child).""" ⏎     return _series_count() > 0 . a_restart_leaves_a_slate_behind_it also declares verb="" in its Probe(...); that line is removed (verb="watch" replaces it). The third standing cc probe, the_shim_delivers_mail (078476729bca), is NOT converted: see the unreceivable decision. Nothing else changes; watch_carry is not edited.

D3: the proof — Create cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_cc_probes_report_to_the_watch.py: a copy of cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py with the docstring naming cairn/devices/cc and ticket 802b3e49ae70; PROVES = {'802b3e49ae70': {'all': 'test_cc_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}; BERTH = 'cairn/devices/cc/probes/'; _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] (the repo root: the directory holding cairn/); teeth renamed test_every_standing_cc_probe_posts_watch, test_every_standing_cc_spec_names_the_receiver and the composite test_cc_probes_report_to_the_watch. Structure, in full: imports importlib, json, subprocess, sys, Path; _REPO_ROOT on sys.path; parse_workflow from cairn.tools.base.transitions; watchme_spec_error from cairn.tools.base.watchme_spec; _main_tree() = Path(git -C _REPO_ROOT rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir).parent falling back to _REPO_ROOT; _tickets() = _main_tree().parent/'CairnCommons'/'tickets'; _standing() = (id, doc, spec) for each ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme spec's probe starts with BERTH, asserting non-empty; the posts tooth imports each probe module and asserts PROBE.verb == 'watch', PROBE.to == 'harbor_master', payload({}) carries ticket == the id, holds a bool, non-empty finding when holds is False (invariants only); the receiver tooth asserts spec['receiver'] == {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} and watchme_spec_error(doc) names no receiver fault; a __main__ block runs each, prints PASS/FAIL, exits 1 on any failure. No classes.

D4: the specs' receiver — Ticket files are /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/<id>-<slug>.json (glob '<id>-*.json', exactly one). For each of 15b80c0c393c, a6cf55a6dd6d: doc = json.loads(Path(p).read_text()); the watchme is a dict or list of dicts; the spec whose 'probe' starts with 'cairn/devices/cc/probes/' gets spec['receiver'] = {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}; then cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(p, json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', verb='cast', why='<id>: the watchme names its receiver, harbor_master\'s watch verb (802b3e49ae70)') — write(path, text, *, verb, why), text the WHOLE modified ticket. Run it as a script file (a shell command naming a record path and writing is refused by the artifact gate).

D5: green, seal, commit — Run cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_cc_probes_report_to_the_watch.py (exit 0) and the probe-importing proofs (test_cc_device, test_groundloop_pulse, test_restart_selector); each must be green. Seal with `bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 900 cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_cc_probes_report_to_the_watch.py <the probe-importing proofs>` (it runs each and writes its validation beside it). Commit with message '802b3e49ae70: cc probes report to the watch' (the commit runs the reseal ladder, so allow an hour); commit the commons.

D6: the unreceivable probe — 078476729bca's probe cairn/devices/cc/probes/the_shim_delivers_mail.py is not edited and its spec gets no receiver. After the two conversions, post one finding to harbor_master's watch verb as a scratch script: from cairn.tools.bus_client import reach; reach('harbor_master').request(sender='cc', to='harbor_master', verb='watch', why='<this ticket id>: no receiver can use this probe', body={'ticket': '078476729bca', 'holds': False, 'finding': "its probe the_shim_delivers_mail triggers on context['diagnostics_received'] > 0, and nothing in cairn, skills or bin sets that key (grep 2026-10-03), so it can never fire or conclude and no receiver can use its data (Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: no sensible receiver -> FIXME)"}). The reply must be accepted, and 078476729bca's workflow_and_state must then read [FIXME, which takes it out of the proof's standing population.

The watch verb moves the cursor itself (harbor_master device.py _handle_watch calls clearance._send_to_fixme): the builder posts reach("harbor_master").request(sender="cc", to="harbor_master", verb="watch", why=..., body={"ticket": <id>, "holds": False, "finding": <finding>}), reads the reply body (reply.get("body", reply)), requires body["accepted"] is True and body["acted"] == "fixme", then requires the substring "[FIXME" in the ticket file's workflow_and_state. The builder never writes workflow_and_state by hand; the exact rendered syntax is clearance's, and the proof tooth test_the_unreceivable_probes_sent_their_tickets_to_fixme asserts only that substring plus a fixme entry of kind "watchme".

The proof is generated by child.py as a full Python copy of cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py with BERTH swapped; _standing() ends with `assert out, f"no standing ticket names a probe under {BERTH} — the population vanished"` (an AssertionError, never silent), and _main_tree/_tickets are the concrete code in that template.

The proof is created by copying the existing file cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py byte for byte (cp), then making ONLY the modifications this ticket lists (docstring, PROVES, BERTH, _REPO_ROOT depth, the three tooth names, plus any tooth this ticket adds). No generator script exists or is used: any earlier mention of child.py names a scratch script of the caster, not something the builder runs. The posts tooth obtains each payload as PROBE.payload({}) — Probe.payload runs the carry over that context.
